news.titleEn: Brazilian stocks rocked as Lula wins presidential election, Bolsonaro reportedly refuses to concede
news.conclusionEn: Lula won a fourth term with 51.8% of the vote, triggering a historic sell-off in Brazilian assets as markets had bet on a Bolsonaro victory.
news.conclusionZh: 卢拉逆转胜选连任，巴西资产遭遇历史性抛售
news.whyEn: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy; a 10%+ currency crash and halted stock exchange ripple through emerging-market funds and commodity-linked portfolios.
news.whyZh: 巴西是拉美最大经济体，雷亚尔暴跌10%冲击新兴市场基金和大宗商品投资
news.detailEn: Lula beat Senator Flávio Bolsonaro 51.8% to 48.2%, becoming the first candidate since 1989 to win a runoff after losing the first round. The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF fell about 25%, Brazil's exchange triggered a circuit breaker, and the real dropped roughly 10.5% against the dollar. Investors fear looser fiscal policy and more state intervention in companies like Petrobras, whose U.S. shares fell 16%. Brazil's Treasury canceled bond auctions set for Oct. 27 and Oct. 29, and Bolsonaro's party later accepted the result.
news.detailZh: 卢拉以51.8%对48.2%击败参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，成为1989年以来首位首轮落后、决选翻盘的候选人。iShares巴西ETF一度暴跌约25%，巴西股市触发熔断，雷亚尔对美元贬值约10.5%。投资者担心财政纪律放松、政府加强干预国企，石油巨头巴西石油美股下跌16%。巴西财政部取消了10月27日和29日的国债拍卖，博索纳罗所在政党随后承认了选举结果。

news.titleEn: Broadcom Arranges $63 Billion Deal to Finance Anthropic's Chips
news.conclusionEn: Bank of America, Citi, Morgan Stanley and Blackstone committed $63 billion through a special purpose vehicle that will buy Broadcom AI chips and lease them to Anthropic.
news.conclusionZh: 四大金融机构630亿美元融资，为Anthropic采购博通AI芯片
news.whyEn: It is one of the largest debt deals tied to the AI build-out, easing doubts over how AI labs will pay for compute and lifting chip stocks.
news.whyZh: 史上最大AI相关债务融资之一，缓解AI算力「谁来买单」的疑虑，带动芯片股
news.detailEn: The financing runs through a newly created special purpose vehicle that purchases Broadcom's custom XPU accelerators and networking gear, then leases them to Anthropic, with deliveries expected from 2027. Banks are lending about $42 billion of senior debt, part of which may be refinanced in the investment-grade bond market in early 2027, while Blackstone provides junior financing. Broadcom backstops part of the deal with residual value support. Broadcom shares rose about 4% on Tuesday and other chipmakers rallied in sympathy.
news.detailZh: 这笔融资通过新设立的特殊目的实体（SPV）进行：SPV购买博通定制XPU加速芯片和网络设备，再租赁给Anthropic，预计2027年开始交付。银行提供约420亿美元优先级贷款，部分可能在2027年初转为投资级债券再融资，黑石提供次级融资。博通以「残值担保」承担部分风险。周二博通股价上涨约4%，其他芯片股同步走高。

news.titleEn: Oil prices fall after Iran supreme leader and top security official discuss conditions to end war
news.conclusionEn: Brent fell 1.7% to $113.88 and WTI dropped below $100 as Iran signaled it wants to end the 'neither war nor peace' state with the U.S.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗释放结束战争信号，WTI油价跌破100美元
news.whyEn: Oil above $100 has fed inflation worldwide; any path to de-escalation around the Strait of Hormuz would ease energy costs for consumers and central banks.
news.whyZh: 高油价推高全球通胀，霍尔木兹海峡局势缓和将减轻消费者和央行压力
news.detailEn: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei met top security official Mohsen Rezaei to discuss conditions for ending the war with the U.S., including maintaining control over the Strait of Hormuz. A day earlier, Saudi Arabia's defense minister held direct talks with Iran's President Pezeshkian in Tehran, joined by Pakistani and Turkish officials. Houthi strikes on Saudi energy infrastructure remain a supply risk. UBS expects Brent to stay near $110 through year-end.
news.detailZh: 伊朗最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊与最高安全官员雷扎伊会面，讨论结束与美国战争的条件，其中包括维持对霍尔木兹海峡的控制。前一天，沙特国防大臣在德黑兰与伊朗总统佩泽希齐扬直接会谈，巴基斯坦和土耳其官员也参与其中。胡塞武装对沙特能源设施的袭击仍是供应风险。瑞银预计布伦特油价到年底仍将维持在110美元附近。

news.titleEn: S&P 500 posts back-to-back winning days as chips rally and oil prices slide: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: The S&P 500 rose 0.6% to 7,722.60 and the Nasdaq gained 1.18% as chip stocks rallied and the Fed began its two-day meeting.
news.conclusionZh: 芯片股领涨，标普500连续两日收高，美联储会议开幕
news.whyEn: The AI trade is back after two weeks of jitters, and markets now await Wednesday's Fed decision and megacap tech earnings.
news.whyZh: AI行情在两周低迷后回暖，市场静待周三美联储决议和科技巨头财报
news.detailEn: Broadcom climbed 4% on the Anthropic financing news, AMD gained 5% and Micron nearly 3%, extending gains sparked by Anthropic's IPO filing. The Dow was nearly flat at 52,377.57. Falling oil prices also helped sentiment. The Federal Reserve announces its rate decision on Wednesday, followed by earnings from several of the largest tech companies this week.
news.detailZh: 受Anthropic融资消息推动，博通上涨4%，AMD涨5%，美光涨近3%，延续了Anthropic提交IPO申请后的涨势。道指基本持平，收于52,377.57点。油价下跌也提振了市场情绪。美联储将于周三公布利率决议，本周还有多家科技巨头发布财报。

news.titleEn: Israeli election results: No clear winner as exit polls suggest rebuke for Netanyahu
news.conclusionEn: Exit polls show neither Netanyahu's bloc (52 seats) nor Gadi Eisenkot's bloc (49 seats) near the 61-seat majority.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列大选无明确赢家，内塔尼亚胡阵营议席大幅缩水
news.whyEn: Israel's next government will shape the Gaza, Iran and regional conflicts that are driving oil prices and Middle East risk.
news.whyZh: 以色列新政府将影响加沙、伊朗等地区冲突走向，牵动油价和中东风险
news.detailEn: In the first election since the October 7 attack, Netanyahu's right-wing and ultra-Orthodox bloc is projected to slump from 68 seats to about 52. Former military chief Eisenkot's bloc has around 49, while Arab parties are set for a record 19 seats. Turnout was the highest since 1999. Final results are expected within 48 hours, but coalition talks could take weeks, with deadlock, a unity government or even another election all possible.
news.detailZh: 这是10·7袭击后的首次大选，出口民调显示内塔尼亚胡的右翼及极端正统派阵营议席预计从68席降至约52席。前总参谋长艾森科特领导的阵营约49席，阿拉伯政党有望拿下创纪录的19席。投票率为1999年以来最高。最终结果预计48小时内公布，但组阁谈判可能耗时数周，僵局、联合政府甚至再次选举都有可能。

news.titleEn: UPS beats quarterly expectations, raises full-year guidance again
news.conclusionEn: UPS posted adjusted EPS of $1.69 on $22.9 billion revenue, beating estimates, and lifted its full-year revenue forecast to about $92.6 billion.
news.conclusionZh: UPS三季度业绩超预期，再次上调全年指引
news.whyEn: As a bellwether for shipping volumes, UPS's upbeat outlook signals goods demand is holding up despite high fuel costs.
news.whyZh: UPS是货运景气风向标，乐观指引显示高油价下商品需求依然稳健
news.detailEn: Revenue rose 6.7% year over year, with domestic revenue up 4.5%, international up 7.1% and supply chain solutions up 18.2%. UPS had expected domestic revenue to be flat as it reduces Amazon volumes. It now projects fourth-quarter revenue of $25.7 billion. The guidance raise follows another increase last quarter.
news.detailZh: 营收同比增长6.7%，其中美国国内业务增长4.5%，国际业务增长7.1%，供应链解决方案业务大增18.2%。此前UPS预计因逐步减少亚马逊业务量，国内营收将持平。公司目前预计第四季度营收为257亿美元。这是继上季度后再次上调全年指引。

news.titleEn: Boeing says it won't significantly ramp up 737 Max production until late 2027
news.conclusionEn: Boeing beat revenue estimates but posted a bigger loss than expected and pushed its 737 Max ramp to 52 jets a month to the second half of 2027.
news.conclusionZh: 波音亏损超预期，737 Max增产推迟到2027年下半年
news.whyEn: Slower deliveries delay Boeing's cash recovery and keep airlines short of new, fuel-efficient planes amid high oil prices.
news.whyZh: 交付放缓拖累波音现金流恢复，高油价下航空公司仍缺少省油新机
news.detailEn: CEO Kelly Ortberg said wing production is the bottleneck, keeping output around 47 737 Max jets a month. Boeing is targeting 52 a month in the second half of 2027. Because most of an aircraft's price is paid at delivery, the production pace is key to Boeing's financial recovery. Ortberg told CNBC the company would rather 'do it right' than go faster.
news.detailZh: 首席执行官奥尔特伯格表示，机翼生产是瓶颈，目前737 Max月产量约47架，目标是2027年下半年达到月产52架。由于飞机大部分货款在交付时支付，生产节奏是波音财务复苏的关键。奥尔特伯格对CNBC表示，公司宁愿「做对」也不求更快。

news.titleEn: Melania Trump-brokered local ceasefire begins as Russia continues attacks on Ukraine
news.conclusionEn: A local ceasefire around Russian-occupied Oleshky took effect to allow humanitarian aid, even as Russia launched up to 16 ballistic missiles and 280 drones at Ukrainian cities.
news.conclusionZh: 奥列什基局部停火生效，俄罗斯同时对乌发动大规模空袭
news.whyEn: It is a rare U.S.-mediated humanitarian pause, but continued strikes on energy infrastructure show broader peace remains distant.
news.whyZh: 罕见的美方斡旋人道停火，但能源设施仍遭袭击，全面和平仍遥远
news.detailEn: The ceasefire began at 3:00 a.m. local time and is due to last until Saturday, letting food, water, medicine and doctors reach Oleshky, which lies across the Dnipro River from Kherson. First Lady Melania Trump initiated the talks after learning about the town's situation during the U.N. General Assembly. Zelenskyy said Russia's overnight targets were mainly energy, logistics and urban infrastructure.
news.detailZh: 停火于当地时间凌晨3点开始，持续至周六，让食品、饮用水、药品和医生得以进入第聂伯河对岸、与赫尔松相望的奥列什基。美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅在联合国大会期间了解到当地情况后发起了这次斡旋。泽连斯基表示，俄罗斯当晚的袭击目标主要是能源、物流和城市基础设施。

news.titleEn: Early third-quarter earnings show a 'resilient' U.S. consumer, with signs of strain
news.conclusionEn: Early Q3 reports from companies like Royal Caribbean and Sherwin-Williams show Americans still spending despite record diesel prices and high borrowing costs.
news.conclusionZh: 三季报显示美国消费者仍具韧性，但压力迹象显现
news.whyEn: Consumer spending drives about two-thirds of the U.S. economy, so its durability shapes the Fed's path and recession odds.
news.whyZh: 消费约占美国经济三分之二，其韧性影响美联储路径和衰退概率
news.detailEn: Retail sales rose 0.8% in September after a 1.3% jump in August, partly boosted by gas station spending. Diesel hit a record $6.52 a gallon in September, raising fears of higher prices across consumer goods. Royal Caribbean reported rising bookings, while Coca-Cola raised its outlook but flagged lackluster North American demand. The mixed picture suggests spending is holding up but becoming more value-driven.
news.detailZh: 9月零售销售增长0.8%，8月增长1.3%，部分受加油站消费推动。9月柴油价格创下每加仑6.52美元的纪录，引发消费品全面涨价的担忧。皇家加勒比游轮预订量上升，可口可乐上调全年展望但提示北美需求疲软。整体来看，消费仍在支撑，但越来越注重性价比。

businessTips.explanationEn: An SPV is a separate legal entity created for one specific project or asset, with its own balance sheet. It isolates risk: if the project fails, creditors usually can only claim the SPV's assets, not the parent company's. Companies use SPVs to raise large amounts of money for a single purpose, share risk with investors, and keep big liabilities off their main balance sheet.
businessTips.explanationZh: 特殊目的实体（SPV）是为某个特定项目或资产专门设立的独立法律主体，拥有自己的资产负债表。它的核心作用是隔离风险：项目失败时，债权人通常只能追偿SPV的资产，而不是母公司。企业常用SPV为单一用途筹集大额资金、与投资者分担风险，并避免巨额负债直接压在主报表上。
businessTips.exampleEn: In today's Broadcom deal, banks and Blackstone fund an SPV that buys AI chips and leases them to Anthropic. Lenders are repaid from Anthropic's lease payments, while Broadcom gets a sale and Anthropic gets compute without paying $63 billion upfront.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在今天的博通交易中，银行和黑石出资设立SPV购买AI芯片，再租给Anthropic。贷款人靠Anthropic的租金回收本息，博通实现销售，Anthropic则无需一次性拿出630亿美元就能获得算力。

businessTips.explanationEn: Many small businesses earn a large share of annual revenue in a few peak weeks, such as Black Friday through Christmas. Seasonal planning means forecasting that spike and preparing inventory, cash, marketing and fulfillment capacity in advance. Ordering too little loses sales at the best time of year; ordering too much ties up cash in unsold stock into January.
businessTips.explanationZh: 很多小生意的全年收入集中在少数旺季几周，比如黑五到圣诞节。旺季规划就是提前预测这波高峰，并提前准备库存、现金、营销和发货能力。备货太少会在一年中最好的时候错失销售，备货太多则会让现金压在卖不掉的库存上一直到一月。
businessTips.exampleEn: An Etsy seller who sold 300 gift sets last December could order supplies by early November for about 350, lock in shipping cut-off dates, and set up an email campaign now. Offering pre-orders for slow-to-make items helps gauge demand before committing cash.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位去年12月卖出300套礼盒的Etsy卖家，可以在11月初前按约350套备料，提前确定物流截止日期，并现在就准备好邮件营销。对制作周期长的商品开放预售，可以在投入资金前先试探需求。

businessTips.explanationEn: A circuit breaker is an automatic rule that pauses trading when an index or stock falls by a set percentage in one session. It gives investors time to absorb news and prevents panic selling from feeding on itself. Thresholds differ by market; in the U.S., an S&P 500 drop of 7%, 13% or 20% triggers marketwide halts.
businessTips.explanationZh: 熔断机制是一种自动规则：当指数或个股在单个交易日内跌幅达到设定比例时，交易会暂停。它让投资者有时间消化消息，防止恐慌性抛售自我强化。不同市场的阈值不同，例如美国标普500指数下跌7%、13%或20%时会触发全市场暂停交易。
businessTips.exampleEn: After Lula's surprise win, Brazil's stock exchange was halted by an automatic circuit breaker as stocks plunged. Investors holding Brazil ETFs abroad, which kept trading, saw the full drop instantly — a reminder that halts pause trading but don't stop prices from repricing.
businessTips.exampleZh: 卢拉意外胜选后，巴西股市暴跌并触发自动熔断。而在海外继续交易的巴西ETF则立刻反映了全部跌幅——这说明熔断只能暂停交易，并不能阻止价格重新定价。
